body: A conversation's profile is derived from its home with exactly one rule: config.ForHome (plan beats api, then default, then config order); config.ProfilesForHome lists every candidate for --json. The resume list column and the profile resume launches on must use the same rule, or the list lies about where a chat opens. Never add a second home-to-profile rule (shipped v0.3.1, 2026-10-14).
